difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for rings endowed with finitely generated ideals and the adic topologies, formal smoothness of a continuous homomorphism is equivalent to formal smoothness of the induced map to the completion of the target, and to that between the two completions. The proof uses that a finitely generated ideal makes the completion adically complete with the expected quotients by powers of the ideal, for both rings, so that the lifting diagrams in the three formulations are in bijective correspondence, which is exactly the equivalence asserted.
